At Boehringer Ingelheim, we are committed to transforming patients' lives through breakthrough science and innovative therapeutic modalities. Oligonucleotide therapeutics, including siRNA-based medicines and targeted RNA delivery technologies, represent one of the most exciting frontiers in modern drug discovery.
To strengthen our growing RNA therapeutics capabilities, we are seeking an experienced and visionary scientist to establish and lead an in-house oligonucleotide chemistry platform within Medicinal Chemistry.
In this highly visible role, you will combine scientific leadership with hands-on laboratory expertise. You will establish laboratory capabilities for oligonucleotide synthesis and characterization, support drug discovery programs across multiple therapeutic areas, and help shape Boehringer Ingelheim's long-term strategy and intellectual property position in siRNA therapeutics, conjugate technologies and tissue-targeted delivery approaches. You will drive the future direction of oligonucleotide-based drug discovery at Boehringer-Ingelheim.
Tasks & responsibilities
As Principal Scientist Oligonucleotide Discovery Platform & RNA Therapeutics, you will:

- Establish, operate, lead and continuously advance Boehringer Ingelheim's in-house oligonucleotide synthesis and characterization laboratory within the Medicinal Chemistry Department.
- Serve as scientific lead for oligonucleotide chemistry, RNA modification strategies and conjugate technologies across Discovery Research.
- Design, synthesize, purify and characterize siRNAs, chemically modified oligonucleotides and oligonucleotide conjugates to support portfolio projects.
- Develop innovative chemical solutions enabling improved potency, durability, safety and tissue-specific delivery of RNA therapeutics.
- Drive the identification, evaluation and implementation of novel RNA-targeting technologies and emerging delivery concepts.
- Build deep expertise in extrahepatic delivery strategies and tissue-targeted RNA therapeutics.
- Collaborate closely with biology, DMPK, translational medicine, pharmaceutical sciences and external partners to advance RNA therapeutic programs.
- Contribute to target assessment and modality selection by evaluating the suitability of RNA-based approaches for challenging disease targets.
- Lead interdisciplinary, global oligonucleotide based projects and drive drug discovery programs from ideation to development candidate.
- Identify opportunities for proprietary innovation and develop sustainable intellectual property positions in oligonucleotide chemistry, RNA modification and conjugate design.
- Support the development of differentiated platform technologies and contribute to patent filings.
- Establish external scientific networks and monitor technological developments across academia, biotechnology and pharmaceutical research.
- Present research findings and project updates to internal stakeholders and external collaborators.
- Mentor scientists and contribute to the development of Boehringer Ingelheim's future oligonucleotide strategy.

Requirements

- PhD in organic chemistry, medicinal chemistry, nucleic acid chemistry, biochemistry or a related discipline.
- Industrial or academic experience in oligonucleotide therapeutics and RNA-targeting drug discovery.
- Strong hands-on expertise in solid-phase oligonucleotide synthesis, purification and analytical characterization.
- Deep understanding of siRNA design principles, chemical modification strategies and conjugate technologies.
- Experience with GalNAc-siRNA, extrahepatic delivery technologies or oligonucleotide-targeting ligands is highly desirable.
- Entrepreneurial mindset with enthusiasm for building new scientific capabilities and platforms.

jobs.description:
Apply Now
Account Executive Specialist (f/m/d) Finance & Spend Mgmt - Procurement Focus

Date: 07/28/2026
Company: SAP

We help the world run better
At SAP, we keep it simple: you bring your best to us, and we'll bring out the best in you. We're builders touching over 20 industries and 80% of global commerce, and we need your unique talents to help shape what's next. The work is challenging – but it matters. You'll find a place where you can be yourself, prioritize your wellbeing, and truly belong. What's in it for you? Constant learning, skill growth, great benefits, and a team that wants you to grow and succeed.

Role Overview

The Solution Sales Executive (SSE) / Account Executive Specialist (f/m/d) is a strategic leader who combines deep SAP expertise, business acumen, and end-to-end solution area domain knowledge to drive LoB cloud revenue, customer success, accelerate adoption of innovation (especially AI), and position the organization as a market leader. Within the Finance & Spend Management LoB, you will be working in one of our three sales teams with a primary focus on Procurement, and be responsible for our portfolio including SAP Ariba and SAP Fieldglass. The SSE shapes transformative solutions and delivers measurable value to customers through thought leadership, innovation, and strategic execution—supporting both specific Lines of Business (LoB) and the overall “One SAP” strategy.

Key Responsibilities include

- Lead Efforts: Establish, develop, and expand market share for SAP’s Spend - Procurement solutions within named accounts in Germany
- Pipeline & Opportunity Management: Build and execute a strong pipeline for Spend to achieve the quarterly and yearly sales target.
- Account Ownership & Strategy: Serve as the LoB owner for assigned accounts, developing and executing strategic account plans that align with customer goals, business objectives and broader account plans by account team.
- Drive End-to-End Customer Value Journey with Domain Expertise: Provide solution area domain expertise and thought leadership to understand and address high-priority business challenges. Lead end-to-end process mapping and the customer value journey, owning the transformation roadmap for the LoB.
- Enablement, Demos & Prototypes: Support solution advisors to ensure demo system readiness and manage enablement programs. Collaborate with Demo & Learning teams to provide updated assets and trial environments as part of scalable enablement programs as well as customized demos, POCs and prototypes with customer specific data.
- Value Proposition & Executive Engagement: Collaborate with value advisors to create compelling narratives articulating ROI, value leakage and competitive advantages. Conduct strategic discovery, run value leakage, AOTP workshops and deliver persuasive pitches with ways of solving distinct customer business/buying-center challenges to accelerate executive buy-in and drive demand independently of RFPs.
- Commercial Negotiations: Navigate complex pricing and contractual discussions, balancing client expectations with organizational profitability and cloud revenue growth.
- Adoption & Consumption: Support Customer Success Management (CSM) communities, secure references, and manage escalations. Collaborate with CS and CS&D adoption teams to ensure successful delivery of solutions and services, monitoring outcomes and driving continuous improvement to maximize customer value.
- Customer Success & Field Impact: Own LoB deal cycles, renewals, enablement, and executive engagement. Elevate customer discussions to prioritize investment and drive measurable outcomes.
- Relationship Building & Governance: Drive C-suite engagements and Buying Center Alignment by fostering long-term high-value relationships and convert executives into advocates and brand ambassadors. Conduct Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) with customers and internal stakeholders focused on solution adoption, innovation, risks and opportunities.
- Ecosystem & Partner Engagement: Own relationships with strategic consulting partners (e.g., McKinsey, Bain, Accenture, Deloitte, PwC, EY) to co-innovate, develop joint go-to-market strategies, and shape disruptive solutions. Maintain direct, high-quality relationships with partner account leads.
- Collaboration & Orchestration: Align closely with Sales, Product, and Marketing to ensure SAL impact is fully integrated into the go-to-market engine with tailored GTM approach. Drive joint accountability and coordination across internal stakeholders for maximum market impact.
- Competitive & Industry Expertise: Maintain deep technical and functional knowledge across SAP solutions. Stay at the forefront of emerging technologies and competitive trends to craft differentiated solutions that win in the market.

Qualifications & Competencies

- 
7+ years of professional sales experience, with SAP Spend solutions (Beneficial: Procurement, Sourcing/Contracts, Finance/AP, ERP, Business Technology Platform or Workforce Management), SaaS solutions, VMS or Procurement

- 
Relationships in procurement and finance communities (e.g. CIOs, CPOs, CFOs, procurement/finance directors, Head of Direct or Indirect Proc. etc.) of advantage

- 
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Information Technology, or related field.

- 
B2B enterprise experience with multi-stakeholder SaaS cycles, plus top-tier consulting and deep industry expertise.

- 
Strong understanding of solution sales, customer value realization, and account planning methodologies; Expansion selling track record (account growth).

- 
Deep SAP and domain expertise, with strong understanding of AI and innovation trends.

- 
Maps value levers and tell a quantified ROI storytelling and compelling business case creation

- 
Strategic thinking, business acumen, relationship building and client advocacy skills.

- 
Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management abilities.

- 
Ability to work collaboratively in a matrixed environment and influence without direct authority.

- 
Analytical mindset with a focus on problem-solving and continuous improvement.

- 
Excellent verbal and written communication skills in German (min. C1 level) and English

Why This Role Matters

The SSE is pivotal in shaping SAP’s market leadership by delivering transformative solutions, driving innovation (especially in AI), and orchestrating value across the customer lifecycle. This role is at the intersection of strategy, technology, and relationship management, ensuring customers realize the full value of their SAP investments while positioning the organization for sustained growth.

​

Bring out your best
SAP innovations help more than four hundred thousand customers worldwide work together more efficiently and use business insight more effectively. Originally known for leadership in enterprise resource planning (ERP) software, SAP has evolved to become a market leader in end-to-end business application software and related services for database, analytics, intelligent technologies, and experience management. As a cloud company with two hundred million users and more than one hundred thousand employees worldwide, we are purpose-driven and future-focused, with a highly collaborative team ethic and commitment to personal development. Whether connecting global industries, people, or platforms, we help ensure every challenge gets the solution it deserves. At SAP, you can bring out your best.

We win with inclusion
SAP’s culture of inclusion, focus on health and well-being, and flexible working models help ensure that everyone – regardless of background – feels included and can run at their best. At SAP, we believe we are made stronger by the unique capabilities and qualities that each person brings to our company, and we invest in our employees to inspire confidence and help everyone realize their full potential. We ultimately believe in unleashing all talent and creating a better world.

SAP is committed to the values of Equal Employment Opportunity and provides accessibility accommodations to applicants with physical and/or mental disabilities. If you are interested in applying for employment with SAP and are in need of accommodation or special assistance to navigate our website or to complete your application, please send an e-mail with your request to Recruiting Operations Team: Careers@sap.com.

jobs.occupation: Controller (m/f/d) European Logistics & Supply Chain Finance (Controller/in)
jobs.description:
Development Perspective: Future Team Leadership

As part of a structured succession planning process, we are looking for a Controller (m/f/d) European Logistics & Supply Chain Finance who is motivated to take on increasing responsibility and further develop their career within an international environment.

In this role, you will work closely with the current Team Lead and gain comprehensive insight into the financial steering of our European logistics organization. Over time, you will be systematically introduced to broader responsibilities and leadership-related tasks. This position offers a clear perspective to assume the Team Lead role for European Logistics & Supply Chain Finance in the future as part of our long-term succession planning.

Your Responsibilities:

- Logistics Cost Controlling: Partner closely with the logistics organization to perform budget-to-actual analyses, ad hoc evaluations, scenario analyses, and management reporting.
- Budgeting & Forecasting: Prepare annual budgets, periodic forecasts, and financial outlooks.
- Closing Activities:Support month-end and year-end closing processes.
- Management Reporting: Prepare, analyze, and continuously improve monthly management reports and KPIs.
- Support the strategic planning of European logistics operations and develop business cases for the development of the European warehouse footprint.
- Inventory ControllingAnalyze inventory levels, inventory variances,  rework and scrapping activities to track financial impacts and identify risks and opportunities.
- Projects & Process Improvements:Participate in international and cross-functional projects with a focus on enhancing controlling processes, reporting standards, and digital tools.
- Leadership Exposure: Collaborate closely with the current Team Lead, gaining insight into leadership responsibilities, stakeholder management, and strategic decision-making processes.

Your Profile:

- Degree in Business Administration, Finance, Business Informatics, Industrial Engineering, or a comparable qualification
- Relevant experience in Controlling, Finance, or a related analytical business partnering role, ideally in an international environment
- Business analytical skills, interest in numbers and data, and the expertise to translate financial insights into business recommendations
- Competent knowledge of Excel and BI tools; SAP knowledge as a plus
- Structured, proactive, and solution-oriented working style combined with collaboration skills
- Communication and stakeholder management skills across different organizational levels
- Interest in taking on additional responsibility and developing toward a leadership position
- Good command of German and English 
- Willingness to travel according to business need within Europe

What We Offer:

- A genuine succession opportunity**:** This position has been created as part of a long-term succession plan. You will work closely with the current Team Lead and be systematically prepared for broader responsibilities and a potential future leadership role.
- A challenging and impactful role within an international organization and a highly motivated team.
- The opportunity to actively shape and further develop our European Logistics & Supply Chain Finance Controlling organization.
- Flexible working hours, hybrid working options, and 30 days of annual leave.
- Capital-forming benefits and company pension scheme.
- EGYM Wellpass corporate fitness membership.
- Employee discounts, JobRad bicycle leasing, complimentary fruit, water and coffee, and additional attractive benefits.

jobs.description:
**The following challenges await you:** 

- You will join the newly established Corporate Development function as a key sparring partner, shaping the long-term strategic direction of Heraeus Convantics through 2035.
- From day one, you will engage with both CEOs and the Leadership Team on the questions that matter most: where to grow, where to focus, which new business fields to build, and how to position the company in a changing market environment.
- In this role, you will take topics end-to-end – from structuring and analyzing complex problems & trends to translating findings into clear, decision-ready recommendations for senior leadership. Selected strategic initiatives will be delegated to you with full execution responsibility, so you can see your work translate into real outcomes.
- You will work across all five Business Lines, collaborate closely with leaders from across the organization, and engage with external partners as needed. Topics will range from new business field development and footprint decisions to portfolio choices and strategic M&A evaluations – with a future-back perspective focused on long-term value creation.
- Beyond your day-to-day work on strategic topics, you will help shape how the function operates from the ground up – defining methodologies and establishing Corporate Development as a high-impact contributor to the company’s long-term direction. For ambitious people with clear leadership ambitions, this is a role designed to build board strategic depth and open the path to future leadership responsibility.

Your Profile:

- Master's degree (or equivalent) in business, economics, management, engineering, or a related field
- 3–5 years of professional experience, ideally with a foundation in strategy consulting, complemented by industry experience and/or corporate development exposure
- Proven track record on complex strategic projects with senior-management visibility – ideally including portfolio strategy, new business development, or transformation work
- High ownership mindset – comfortable taking topics from initial structuring all the way to actionable recommendations, with strong personal accountability
- Driven by curiosity – a genuine interest for Semiconductors, Datacom, Photonics, Materials, AI and emerging future trends, paired with the ability to quickly build expertise in unfamiliar topics and industries
- Strong problem-solving and analytical skills – ability to structure ambiguity and translate insights into actionable recommendations
- Confident communicator – able to produce high-quality strategic content and engage credibly with senior stakeholders, both verbally and in writing
- Leadership ambition – this role offers a clear development path for those who want to grow into a broader scope
- Comfortable working across cultures, functions and global locations
- Business-fluent in English, German is a strong plus

What you can look forward to at Heraeus Covantics:

- Attractive compensation – in addition to a competitive salary package, you’ll benefit from comprehensive benefits offered by a responsible family-owned company
- Flexible time off – 30 days of annual leave plus up to 6 additional days off (company holidays on long weekends and between Christmas and New Year’s), special leave for special occasions, and a lifetime working time account for paid time off (e.g., early retirement)
- Sustainability & social commitment – sustainability as an integral part of the corporate strategy, as well as targeted support for educational, family, and scientific initiatives through our own foundations
- Modern workplace – ergonomic workspace in an open-plan office with modern equipment, a laptop of your choice, two additional monitors, an iPhone (also for personal use), and height-adjustable desks
- Additional benefits – subsidies for public transportation, discounts at numerous (online) stores, an on-site medical service with comprehensive preventive health checkups, sports programs, and an employee cafeteria with meals freshly prepared daily

About us

Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
Job description

We at Airbus Defence and Space in Ottobrunn are looking for a Project Management Officer (m/f/d) for the area “Connected Intelligence” in the Programme Unit “Space Digital / Secure Connectivity DACH”.

Our activities are growing and we are looking for you! Experienced in project management? Familiar with proposal phases and the bidding process? Then this might be your next role!

** Your location**

Our site is just a stone's throw away from Munich, the beautiful capital of Bavaria. Are you into sports and other outdoor activities? The Alps and Lake Starnberg are within an hour’s reach, offering a multitude of recreational options.

** Our Benefits for You**

- Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines.
- Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities.
- Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives.
- Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations.
- Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.

You will be part of a high value campaign for the German customer requiring a strong, skilled and highly motivated multifunctional team.

The PMO framework is well outlined and characterized by Airbus Corporate Standardization Documents. Accordingly, the Project Management Officer shall deliver methods, processes and tools in support to the Bid/Project team and act as co-pilot.

Your tasks and responsibilities:

- Maintain the Project Management Plan and ensure adherence to this plan
- Manage the Project Management digital ecosystem to operate the project (e.g. Unified Planning, ADProjects, ARM, collaboration tools)
- Prepare and facilitate meetings and support preparation of milestones
- Act as PM co-pilot in proactively planning and preparing Maturity Gates
- Maintain the project’s action register and drive the timely closure of actions
- Coordinate preparation of reports in various formats for both internal and external customers
- Maintain the project’s integrated plan in the appropriate toolset (e.g. Unified Planning), embedding inputs from all contributing stakeholders
- Identify and track the project’s critical path, and propose measures to shorten it
- Maintain the Risk and Opportunity (R&O) Management Plan of the project
- Maintain the R&O register, including facilitation, capture, and assessment of risks and opportunities
- Drive the definition and follow-up of R&O mitigation actions, organise the necessary project R&O reviews
- Prepare and contribute to project export control related activities
- Proactively seek out and implement improvements in your way of working, and in the overall execution of the project

Desired skills and qualifications:

- You have successfully completed studies in Engineering or Business Administration with multiple years of experience in leading projects or as a PMO
- An Airbus PMO Certification / PMP certification would be a plus
- You are able to understand technical complexities and risks of our projects
- You can anticipate needs and issues in support of the Project Manager and act as co-pilot
- You have excellent communication and facilitation skills
- You feel comfortable working across functions, in international teams and environments, and influencing and persuading stakeholders amid conflicting priorities
- You master typical office applications and are generally well-versed in digital tools, with experience in standard scheduling tools (e.g. Unified Planning)
- You have a very good command of German and English (written and spoken)
- You are able to get security clearances (GE national)
